newsitem.title: JAPAN: THK shares hit 1997 high on rating upgrade.
newsitem.headline: THK shares hit 1997 high on rating upgrade.

text.p: Shares of THK Co Ltd rose to a high for this year in Tokyo on Tuesday on news that Yamaichi Research Institute of Securities and Economics Inc had upgraded the firm's rating to a "1" from its previous "2".
As of 0121 GMT, the shares stood at 2,210 yen, compared with the Monday close of 2,150. They rose as high as 2,220, a trading high for 1997. THK's turnover was 177,100 shares.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the Tokyo Stock Exchange first-section TOPIX index by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
